briefings.message: Drew Rasmussen is the high-confidence expected starter. Be ready for his fastballs, especially early, but stay disciplined: his changeup has a 36.1% whiff rate and a .193 xwOBA allowed overall. Yordan Alvarez has a .477 xwOBA against fastballs, and Jeremy Peña and Isaac Paredes also fit the fastball plan. Make Rasmussen work rather than expanding. Late, be ready for Bryan Baker and Tyler Wells, likely Rays bullpen options.
reminders: Hunt fastballs; don’t chase the changeup out of the zone.
Stay selective and make Rasmussen earn outs.
Expect Bryan Baker or Tyler Wells late.

briefings.headline: Lambert sets the tone; attack Tampa Bay’s top threats with a plan
briefings.message: Peter Lambert starts, with a five-inning target and a 90-pitch limit. Keep Yandy Díaz in the zone and avoid predictable breaking balls. Use changeups below the zone to Jonathan Aranda, and attack Junior Caminero with breaking stuff when ahead while keeping fastballs out of the middle. Work ahead of Chandler Simpson, limit free baserunners, and control his running game. Bryan King and Enyel De Los Santos are rested options; Miguel Ullola is the first choice for length if Lambert exits early. Josh Hader, Bryan Abreu, and Bennett Sousa are limited after pitching yesterday, so use them selectively.
